mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows multiple decisions to be recorded for the same application. The assertion FR_010_DecisionExclusivity checks that at most one decision exists per application, which is the core invariant preventing concurrent decision conflicts (FR-010, FR-012, SC-005).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultipleDecisions { some app: LoanApplication | some disj d1, d2: Decision | d1.application = app and d2.application = app }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows customers to submit multiple applications simultaneously while both remain in pending review status. The assertion checks the core business rule (FR-005) that enforces at most one in-flight application per customer.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultiplePendingApps { some c: User | some disj app1, app2: LoanApplication | app1.customer = c and app2.customer = c and app1.status = PendingReview and app2.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows customers with Customer role to record decisions on applications. The assertion enforces the critical security invariant (FR-015) that only bank staff can approve or reject applications.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CustomerDecision { some dec: Decision | dec.decided_by.role = Customer }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows duplicate audit events to exist for the same application, actor, and timestamp. This violates the append-only invariant (FR-016) which requires that audit log entries are immutable and non-duplicable.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditEvent { some evt1, evt2: ApplicationEvent | evt1 != evt2 and evt1.application = evt2.application and evt1.actor = evt2.actor and evt1.occurred_at = evt2.occurred_at }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows applications to exist without any audit events recorded. The assertions check that every application has at least one audit entry, which is required by FR-016 to maintain a complete audit trail of all status changes.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditEntry { some app: LoanApplication | no evt: ApplicationEvent | evt.application = app }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact removes the definition of which role-operation pairs are allowed. The assertion checks that the permission matrix correctly encodes the least-privilege access control model (FR-015), preventing unauthorized role-operation combinations.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadPermissions { (Customer -> RecordDecision) in PermMatrix.Allowed or (BankStaff -> SubmitApplication) in PermMatrix.Allowed }
